title: [replaced] compat: return HTTP 400 when digests parameter is passed to /images/json
body:
When using the Docker-compat endpoint `/images/json` with the `digests` query parameter set to `true`, the server returned an empty response body with HTTP 200 status. This was caused by `utils.UnSupportedParameter` only logging an info message without writing any HTTP response, so the early return left the client with a 200 and no body.

This fix replaces the silent log call with a proper HTTP 400 Bad Request error response, matching the behavior expected by Docker-compatible clients. The digest information is already exposed through the `RepoDigests` field in the normal response, so there is no need to support the parameter separately.

Closes #29210
